author: Spoookeh
body:
Hello again,

I was recently organising a scrim for my team while on vacation, I therefore had to use Minechat. We (Berzerk) were trying to scrim against Fortissimus and they decided to allow Michael (Newcleus or JOHN_CENAAAA) to sub for them. He used excessive caps and spam in the chat and I'm pretty sure that rules are now being enforced on scrim servers, if not then don't bother looking at the following evidence xD

Evidence (Imgur album): http://imgur.com/a/wALqM

Bare in mind this was all from perspective in Minechat, I can ask my teammates for screenshots actually in game, thanks.
